Booking policy

  • Clients must be 18+ with photo ID.
  • A 30% deposit confirms your booking and comes off the final price.
  • Reschedule with 48 hours notice to move your deposit. Late cancellations and no-shows forfeit it.
  • Aftercare instructions are given at your appointment.
